Definition: from G142; bread (as raised) or a loaf:--(shew-)bread, loaf.
BiblicalUsage: Bread is the staff of life and the sign of the Life, and the New Testament will not let you forget either. Man shall not live by bread alone, Jesus teaches us to pray for our daily bread, He says I am the bread of life, and at the table He takes bread, breaks it and says this is My body.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe bread is the one food that carries the whole gospel: the daily bread we ask for, the living bread who came down from heaven, and the broken bread of the supper. God feeds His people with bread, and then He gives them Himself as bread, and I hold that no one who comes to Him hungry goes away empty.
